clue.text: On border, secure deadly plant

parts.note: a hem is the folded border of a garment
to lock is to secure, as a door

explanation.surface: A gardener fixes a poisonous plant onto the edge of a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Hemlock is a poisonous umbellifer, famous for killing Socrates.

clue.text: About fifty shapes distorted — so unfortunate!

indicators.note: about means the rearranged word goes round the other piece
distorted means twisted out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone bemoans fifty misshapen objects as a sorry state of affairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distorted' turns SHAPES into HAPESS, and 'About' puts it round L.
explanation.definitionFit: Hapless means luckless, dogged by bad luck.

clue.text: Becoming adept in the art of placing one flower in a Chinese vase

indicators.note: in means the flower is placed inside the vase

parts.note: a Ming vase comes from China's Ming dynasty
an aster is a daisy-like flower

explanation.surface: The fine art of arranging a single bloom in a porcelain vase.
explanation.walkthrough: Ming vases are prized Chinese porcelain from the Ming dynasty.
explanation.definitionFit: Mastering a skill is gaining full command of it.

clue.text: Poem about a concert hall

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: A poem written about a concert venue.
explanation.definitionFit: The Odeon was a building for music in ancient Greece, and the name went to cinemas.

clue.text: Brand the French set alight

parts.note: brand means kind or sort
le is French for the

explanation.surface: French people branded and set on fire.
explanation.definitionFit: To kindle a fire is to light it.

clue.text: Almost the reason for nervous spasm that's severe

indicators.note: almost means the word is taken short of its final letter

parts.note: the reason is the cause
a tic is an involuntary nervous twitch

explanation.surface: Someone asks what lies behind a harsh nervous twitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Almost' trims the final letter of the word for the reason; 'reason for' reads like a cause of the spasm but just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Caustic remarks are bitingly harsh, a figurative sense of corrosive.

clue.text: Sort of bank to be seen in a dell

definitions.meaning: a type of bank that settles cheques through a central system
an open space found among trees, such as in a wooded dell

explanation.walkthrough: A clearing bank is a British high-street bank that processes cheques through the clearing system.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses name an open space, one in a wood, and one in banking settlement of cheques.

clue.text: Girl victim of mugger quite undaunted

parts.note: Una is a girl's name
a mugger's victim is bashed, beaten

explanation.surface: A girl who was mugged remains completely unafraid.
explanation.definitionFit: Unabashed means unembarrassed and not cowed in the least.

clue.text: Object that's approved

definitions.meaning: an object is an item or article
the done ..., what is fashionable or acceptable

explanation.definitionFit: Both an article in general and, as 'the done thing', what is socially acceptable.

clue.text: Around noon thirteen witches, after early start, assemble

indicators.note: after means this piece comes after the rest
around means the witches' group goes round the letter

parts.note: a coven traditionally numbers thirteen witches

indicators.note: start means only the first letter of early is used

explanation.surface: A coven of thirteen witches gathers around midday.
explanation.walkthrough: COVEN goes round N, and E, the first letter of 'early', comes after.
explanation.definitionFit: To convene is to come together for a meeting.

clue.text: Gate holding river back

parts.note: the Po is Italy's longest river
the stern is the back of a ship

explanation.surface: A gate keeps the waters of a river at bay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' is only a link here; the river and the back simply sit side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A postern is a small back or side gate in a castle wall.

clue.text: Roman road one's misdirected to proves elusive

definitions.note: an adjective standing for the noun: the definition reads as what proves elusive

indicators.note: something misdirected is sent the wrong way, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: via is Latin for road, as in the Via Appia
one's gives ONES, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A traveller on an old Roman road is sent the wrong way and gets lost.
explanation.walkthrough: VIA plus ONES are rearranged by 'misdirected'. The definition is loose as printed: 'proves elusive' points to the act of eluding.
explanation.definitionFit: Evasion is the act of slipping away or dodging, being elusive.

clue.text: Figure of never ending fascination to readers of sex drama?

definitions.text: Figure of never ending fascination to readers of sex drama?

parts.words: Figure of never ending fascination to readers of sex drama?
parts.note: a geometric shape described as lasting forever, really the three-person love affair at the heart of many romantic plots

explanation.surface: A character who never stops gripping fans of steamy fiction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Figure' suggests a person, but it is a geometric figure, and 'never ending' is its qualifier.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a love affair involving three people, a stock situation in romantic drama.

clue.text: This flight takes a roundabout route

definitions.text: This flight takes a roundabout route

parts.words: This flight takes a roundabout route
parts.note: seems to be a plane taking a detour, but is a flight of stairs that winds round and round

explanation.surface: An airline service that goes the long way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' suggests air travel; it is a flight of stairs coiling upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A winding staircase coils round a central column as it climbs.

clue.text: Instrument to change time, internally

indicators.note: internally means the word time goes inside the other piece

parts.note: change means alter

explanation.surface: A device for altering the time from the inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change time' looks like resetting a clock, but 'internally' tells you the word for time goes inside the word for change.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a gauge that measures height above sea level, used in aircraft.

clue.text: Measure a toe that's broken and not yet set

parts.note: an inch is a measure of length

indicators.note: broken means the letters of a toe are shattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A broken toe, measured by the doctor, has not yet been set in plaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's broken' looks like it describes the toe, but signals the rearrangement; 'set' suggests a bone set in plaster, but means formed.
explanation.definitionFit: Inchoate means only just begun and not fully formed or developed.

clue.text: Quality, but a trite use for it

indicators.note: use means the letters are put to work in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A good quality, though a hackneyed purpose for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'use' rearranges BUT A TRITE.
explanation.definitionFit: An attribute is a characteristic or feature.

clue.text: In a way, a trendy tax, but steep

indicators.note: in means the letter a sits inside the abbreviation for way

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
U means upper-class or socially acceptable
a rate is a local tax

explanation.surface: A fashionable charge imposed somehow, but very high.
explanation.walkthrough: U as a mark of the socially acceptable comes from the old 'U and non-U' class labels. 'steep' is a verb: soak.
explanation.definitionFit: To steep something is to soak it thoroughly, filling it with liquid.

clue.text: That last drink going to your head?

definitions.text: That last drink going to your head?

parts.words: That last drink going to your head?
parts.note: a final drink before bed, also something worn on the head while sleeping

explanation.surface: A warning that the final glass of the evening may make you tipsy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going to your head' looks like intoxication, but also means worn on the head: the old cap for bed.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a drink taken before bed and a cap once worn in bed.

clue.text: Three in-out-and not one nor the other

indicators.note: out means the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Three people dithering between going in and going out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges THREE IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Neither means not either of two.

clue.text: Book-maker seen to ride off course

indicators.note: off course means straying from the proper line, so the letters go astray

explanation.surface: A bookie is spotted riding a horse that strays off the racecourse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book-maker' suggests a bookie at the races; it is the person who prepares a book. 'off course' rearranges TO RIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: An editor prepares and shapes a book for publication.

clue.text: A recent scheme'- controversial-to pass another law

indicators.note: controversial suggests disputed, so the letters of a recent are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A new scheme is contested by those trying to pass a further law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'controversial' rearranges A RECENT; 'scheme' belongs only to the surface, a new plan that some dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass a law again is to make it once more statute.

clue.text: Very noisy, disturbing nap? Nonsense!

indicators.note: disturbing means the loud letters break into the other piece

parts.note: nap is the pile of a fabric
FF, fortissimo, is the musical mark for very loud

explanation.surface: A loud noise wakes someone from a snooze, and they cry rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nap' looks like a snooze, but is the raised surface of cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Piffle is trivial nonsense, rubbish talk.

clue.text: Conversing, converse

parts.note: talking freely is being in communication; the opposite of that is being unwilling to talk

explanation.surface: Talking, and then the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converse' looks like another word for talk, but means the opposite of 'Conversing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unwilling to talk or share information is reticent and tight-lipped.

clue.text: Goddess heard in sequence

indicators.note: heard means the word is spoken and recognised by its sound

parts.note: a sequence is a series

explanation.surface: A goddess is listened to in turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Ceres was the Roman goddess of agriculture and grain.

clue.text: A passage 'of Elias translated

indicators.note: translated means the name is turned into another form, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A passage from Elias put into another language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translated' rearranges ELIAS; 'A passage' suggests a text excerpt but is a walkway.
explanation.definitionFit: An aisle is a walkway between rows of seats.

clue.text: The bear goes berserk, to get a drink

indicators.note: going berserk means running wild, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A bear goes on a rampage in search of something to drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes berserk' rearranges THE BEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an infusion of herbs in hot water, a tisane.

clue.text: Flautist loses time playing this passage

indicators.note: playing suggests the musician but here the letters are performed in a new order

explanation.surface: A flute player loses the beat while performing a piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses time' drops a T from FLAUTIST, and 'playing' rearranges what is left. 'passage' suggests a musical passage; it is a bodily one.
explanation.definitionFit: A fistula is an abnormal channel between organs or to the skin, a medical term.

clue.text: Twelfth man's reticence?

definitions.meaning: in cricket the twelfth man is the substitute player, the possessive read as twelfth man is
reticence is restraint in speech or manner

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the twelfth man is a substitute who fields when a player is injured.
explanation.definitionFit: A substitute player is held back in case needed, and holding back emotion is restraint.

clue.text: Peak time for repose

parts.note: eve is a time, the evening or the day before
repose means rest

explanation.surface: The best time for relaxing, a climber might say.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest mountain in the world, in the Himalayas.
